content.comment_body: Hello, I’ve put together several PHP functions to control (read and write inputs, outputs, markers, and VM) [product_name] devices through Ethernet, for example from a Raspberry Pi. The source code is publicly available for download and use on GitLab. Since I don’t have the [product_name] hardware, my ability to provide support is limited. There’s a demo example included, and I expect even PHP beginners will find it accessible.
I'm familiar with this project—it’s extremely useful. Thank you very much!

analysis.insight_summary: The thread discusses community PHP functions developed to control [product_name] devices via Ethernet. Another user confirms these resources are highly beneficial. The developer highlights limited support due to not having the hardware available, which may affect troubleshooting, but the solution remains useful and beginner-friendly.
